Lecture slides with their LaTeX sources, R code and data, free to use and adapt in your own
teaching. Each course site gives its license and how to cite it.

## Courses

### [Lectures on Causal Panel Analysis](https://xuyiqing.github.io/panel-lectures/)

Six lectures on causal inference with panel data: the parametric approach,
difference-in-differences, factorial difference-in-differences, two-way fixed effects, modern
difference-in-differences, and synthetic control.
[Course site](https://xuyiqing.github.io/panel-lectures/) ·
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/xuyiqing/panel-lectures)
